text_en: O Lord , you God of vengeance, you God of vengeance, shine forth!
text_cn: 上主，你是伸冤的天主， 伸冤的天主，求你显出！

text_en: Rise up, O judge of the earth; give to the proud what they deserve!
text_cn: 审判大地的天主，请你起来！ 给骄傲人施以应得的祸灾！

text_en: O Lord , how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked exult?
text_cn: 上主，恶人洋洋得意，要到何时？ 歹徒沾沾自喜，要到何时？

text_en: They pour out their arrogant words; all the evildoers boast.
text_cn: 他们大言不惭，要到何时？ 作恶的人自夸，要到何时？

text_en: They crush your people, O Lord , and afflict your heritage.
text_cn: 上主，他们蹂躏你的百姓， 他们磨难你的子民，

text_en: They kill the widow and the stranger, they murder the orphan,
text_cn: 屠杀寡妇与旅客， 将孤儿置于死地，

text_en: and they say, “The Lord does not see; the God of Jacob does not perceive. ”
text_cn: 他们还说：上主看不见， 雅各伯的天主决不管。

text_en: Understand, O dullest of the people; fools, when will you be wise?
text_cn: 民间的愚昧者！你们应该知悉， 糊涂的人！你们何时才能明白？

text_en: He who planted the ear, does he not hear? He who formed the eye, does he not see?
text_cn: 装置耳朵的，难道自己听不着， 制造眼睛的，难道自己看不到？

text_en: He who disciplines the nations, he who teaches knowledge to humankind, does he not chastise?
text_cn: 训戒万民者，难道自己不惩治， 教导人类者，难道自己无知识？

text_en: The Lord knows our thoughts, that they are but an empty breath.
text_cn: 上主认透人的思念， 原来都是虚幻。

text_en: Happy are those whom you discipline, O Lord , and whom you teach out of your law,
text_cn: 上主，那些受你教训的人， 守你法律者是有福的人，

text_en: giving them respite from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.
text_cn: 你叫他在患难时获享安稳， 直到给恶人们掘下了陷阱。

text_en: For the Lord will not forsake his people; he will not abandon his heritage;
text_cn: 因为上主不拒绝自己的百姓， 上主不遗弃自己的人民。

text_en: for justice will return to the righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
text_cn: 原来公理必归正义的人士， 心地正直的人，必追求公理。

text_en: Who rises up for me against the wicked? Who stands up for me against evildoers?
text_cn: 谁肯奋起替我攻打行凶的人， 谁肯站起替我抵抗作恶的人？

text_en: If the Lord had not been my help, my soul would soon have lived in the land of silence.
text_cn: 若不是上主扶助我， 我的灵魂已归冥所。

text_en: When I thought, “My foot is slipping, ” your steadfast love, O Lord , held me up.
text_cn: 我正在想说：我的脚步快要滑倒。 上主，你就以你的仁爱来扶助我。

text_en: When the cares of my heart are many, your consolations cheer my soul.
text_cn: 忧愁焦思虽然齐集我的心神， 你的安慰却舒畅了我的灵魂。

text_en: Can wicked rulers be allied with you, those who contrive mischief by statute?
text_cn: 若有人冒充法律，制造苦恼， 不义的法庭，岂能与你相好？

text_en: They band together against the life of the righteous, and condemn the innocent to death.
text_cn: 他们残害义人的性命， 判决无辜人的流血刑。

text_en: But the Lord has become my stronghold, and my God the rock of my refuge.
text_cn: 然而上主必定作我的堡垒， 我的天主作我避难的磐石。

text_en: He will repay them for their iniquity and wipe them out for their wickedness; the Lord our God will wipe them out.
text_cn: 他必以他们的罪过来报复他们； 必要用他们的凶恶来消灭他们， 上主我们的天主必要消灭他们。
